 A lullaby. A lullaby they were taught when they were just babies. The same lullaby they now sing to children of their own. The lullaby that brings minds to rest and hearts to heal. 

Now that they rest may the soul of the new generation thrive in the morning but settle down at night with the calm villagers' lullaby.
